name: interior_props_life
note: Seamless idle loops for Black Doctrine interior props (placement library "interior", read-only copies). Only pixels the art already paints as lit (bright + saturated, contrast-checked against the surrounding body) are animated, plus in-silhouette FX: skewed screen scanlines + interlace glitch, glass sheen sweeps, hologram shimmer, rising outlined bubbles in glowing tanks, radar sweep, rotating beacon band, energy pulses along cables/strips, status lights blinking with per-light phase. The prop body is never recoloured and the silhouette (alpha) never changes. Each prop has a full drop-in clip (exact canvas + anchor of the static sprite) and an overlay-only clip. Emitters are in each clip JSON. Phases are seeded per prop id.
selection: All 721 interior placement-library entries (library/interior_structures/pieces). 647 unique single props reviewed (74 multi-prop overview sheets >1000px wide skipped; identical-byte twins listed per clip). Each reviewed by eye (frame 0 / busiest frame / touched-pixel map, zoom frame strips on borderline ones) and graded; B or better ships (A, A-, B+, B), matching building_life. B- (only a couple of tiny LEDs change, does not read) and C dropped.
